# EnterpriseGlue v0.17.1 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.17.0`.

## Highlights

- **plugin-toolchain-images:** Rebuilds the public plugin-installer and Plugin Manager images with patched Alpine OpenSSL runtime packages required by the HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerability gate.

## User and administrator impact

- Plugin-installer and Plugin Manager deployments receive patched libcrypto3 and libssl3 runtime packages without changes to toolchain behavior or configuration.

## Upgrade and compatibility

- Use plugin installer 0.2.3, Plugin Manager 0.1.3, and the matching 0.2.3 runtime/RBAC and 0.1.3 manager Helm charts when consuming the refreshed toolchain image.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- Both Alpine runtime layers upgrade installed packages before adding toolchain utilities so libcrypto3 and libssl3 resolve to the repository's patched versions.
- Pull-request qualification rebuilds both production toolchain images and rejects any remaining HIGH or CRITICAL vulnerability.

## Documentation

- The release fragment records both patched images, matching package versions, coupled chart versions, and vulnerability-gate validation.

## Published packages

| Package | Previous | New | Impact |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `@enterpriseglue/plugin-installer` | `0.2.2` | `0.2.3` | patch |
| `@enterpriseglue/plugin-manager` | `0.1.2` | `0.1.3` | patch |

## Rollback

- Restore either previous toolchain image only in an isolated test environment because the earlier images do not satisfy the current vulnerability gate.

## Validation evidence

- Production multi-architecture plugin image build and deployability checks
- Trivy image scan with HIGH and CRITICAL findings configured to fail the build
- Published-package version discipline and plugin-toolchain release-policy checks

- Release-note fragments: `plugin-toolchain-openssl-refresh`
